_note: Registry of tested charts. Each case holds the birth data, the questions with their options, the answer the engine gave, the true answer reported by the owner, and error tags for every miss. Error tags are defined in suj_engine/LEARNINGS.md. Run node suj_engine/tools/cases_report.js for the scoreboard. Add a case after every owner reported result.

questions.note: Chart showed Jupiter 5th from Moon, Mercury highest Shadbala, Budha Aditya and a Venus antardasha with Venus in D24 house 11. The engine saw them and chose the middle option by typicality.
Promise, dasha and transit all pointed one way. Window Rahu Mars Jupiter 29 Nov 2019 to 19 Jan 2020 is a candidate, the true date is not known.

Strong tenth house promise was read as employment. Flags toward not working were set aside: Saturn in 2nd, Saturn and Rahu aspect on 4th, D10 Sun and Moon in 12th, Mercury in D10 8th, D10 10th empty, 10th lord combust. The window scan found a grade A window in 2025 for job start and it was wrong, so a window alone does not prove the event.

Count was decided by a planet and sign gender heuristic made up by the engine. Not in the owner's methodology and not in the rule library. 11th house Ashtakavarga was 38 and Mars the karaka was in a dual sign, both ignored.

Engine itself listed Jupiter, lord of the father's 8th, in the father's 2nd, Saturn and Rahu aspect on the father's 8th, and a Rahu Mercury window in 2010 and 2011 with Saturn in Virgo and Jupiter in Pisces on that house. These were set aside using the Saturn winner and typicality. Father not alive is the truth.

reruns.note: Generated evidence, owner rules to round 12. Every hypothesis scored under 50. Answers Graduation, Unmarried, Not working, Only child, Neither alive. Right on work and on the father only, wrong on the rest. Pessimistic by structure, see rerun_892_round12_results.md. Hindsight run, not a test.

questions.note: Working scored 47 so the rule says not working. Lawyer was the best of the three professions, 51 against Astrologer 45 and Doctor 40, and passed 50. Housewife as the complement scores 53, a margin of 2.
Married 39 and Happy marriage 33, both under 50. The tally cannot tell unhappy from separation from divorce, so the first of the three was taken.

No strict window covers 3 May 2021 for any option. The wide view marks marriage, Mercury Mahadasha, Venus Antardasha, Mercury Pratyantardasha, 7th and 10th lord. The child event was missed because the scan reads D1 houses only. Mercury sits in the 5th house of D7 and Venus is exalted in the D7 Lagna, Jupiter transited Aquarius which is the 5th from the Moon. Round 14, the scan was extended to D7 and to the Moon and Sun transits. The child event is then reached only under the widest view at grade B, marriage stays at grade A, so the answer would still be marriage.
